summary: An agent asks the user for a secret through the Switchboard MCP tool request_secret. The chat shows a card with a masked input; Switchboard writes the value to a private 0600 file for that chat only and tells the agent the file path and the env var SWITCHBOARD_SECRETS_DIR, never the value. Step 1 (this change): the file store (main/secrets/secret-store.ts: a 0700 root excluded from Time Machine and Spotlight, a 0300 folder per chat named by 128 random bits, writes through a wx .partial file and a rename, expiry timers, a sweep at start, every 15 minutes and at quit) and the agent_secret_dirs and agent_secrets tables (metadata only, keyed by the root conversation). Nothing calls save yet, so no user can see a change.

desktop.followUpRelease: The release that turns agent_secret_request on (design section 12, step 6). The MCP tool and broker come in step 2 and the desktop card in step 3. Until then nothing writes a secret; the start sweep finds no secrets folder and does nothing.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: Design section 12, step 5: a read-only card with Decline and Answer this on your computer. No phone enters a secret in v1.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Design section 12, step 5: the same read-only card as the Expo app.

sharedBackendApi.followUpRelease: Design section 12, step 2: the request_secret tool, the sbsec_ card payload and capability agent_secret_request_v1. No channel or event changes in this step.

automated: tests/unit/secret-store.test.ts: folder modes (root 0700, chat folder 0300 and not listable, file 0600), Spotlight marker and backup exclusion, exact bytes with no .partial left, name and size rules, a symlink at the .partial path is refused and its target untouched, a second save replaces the file and retires the old row, a failed record deletes the file, extend, delete now, expiry by timer, archive removes files, folder and dir row, the sweep removes expired files, orphan folders, .partial and unknown files and keeps live ones, and the folder and rows follow a session id rotation to the root conversation.
hardware: The migration ran against a copy of a real 1.1 GB profile database (1,450 conversations): both tables were created and PRAGMA integrity_check answered ok.
notExercised: tmutil addexclusion was not checked against a real Time Machine setup; tests inject the exclusion step.
No packaged build was started in this step: nothing calls the store yet besides the sweeps.
